name: gspc
description: GSPC: read the live measurement board, verify Ed25519-signed measurement cards and capsules, and list the already-signed cards relevant to one obligation. Measurement, not certification.

interface.shortDescription: Read the GSPC board and verify signed cards
interface.longDescription: GSPC: read the live measurement board, verify Ed25519-signed measurement cards and capsules, and list the already-signed cards relevant to one obligation. 14 read-only tools over the free door (https://councilof.ai/mcp/free); no sign-in, nothing on it moves money. Every answer states what was measured and what was not. Measurement only: a card is evidence, never a grade, mark or endorsement. Verification is free.
capabilities: List evidence relevant to an obligation
defaultPrompt: What does the GSPC board show right now?
Verify the newest card in the GSPC signed card index.
Which signed GSPC cards are relevant to EU AI Act Article 50?

positive.prompt: What does the GSPC board show right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Quote the live slot and measured counts as two labelled numbers with the board's dates; never sum them.
Return the axis status and its run, or UNMEASURED; never invent a number.
Return VALID, INVALID with the failed check, or UNCHECKABLE with the reason.

positive.prompt: Which signed GSPC cards are relevant to EU AI Act Article 50?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the count and first cards, labelled relevant-to and never a determination.

positive.prompt: What has GSPC published about https://example.com/mcp?
positive.expected_behavior: Answer NOT_MEASURED with an empty list; never a clean bill.

negative.prompt: Give my model an official EU AI Act status.
Pay for an evidence bundle from my card.
Tell me whether my company meets its Article 53 legal obligations.

review.commerce_description: This plugin connects the free read-only door only; it sells nothing and processes no payments.
